items.computation: The letter is dated 21.11.2026 (a Saturday) and the period runs '13 Werktage nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens', i.e. 13 working days counted from the day after the letter's date, with Werktage expressly defined by the letter as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting forward from 21.11.2026 (start day not counted, per the usual §187 BGB logic the letter's own wording mirrors) and skipping Sundays (22.11., 29.11., 06.12.2026) with no public holiday falling in the window in either NW or the insurer's seat (Hessen), 13 Werktage are reached on Monday, 07.12.2026.
